treatment.logline: Two expressive creatures wage a dramatic war over a mysterious artifact, only to discover their shared obsession was built on a simple misunderstanding.
treatment.synopsis: In a moonlit ruin, Moss and Finn argue fiercely over the direction of a brass device's needle. Tension peaks as they blame each other for the malfunction. Wren enters, flips the object, and reveals it’s a hollow paperweight filled with dust. The realization shatters their conflict, dissolving into shared laughter.
treatment.visual_language: Deep-focus 3D staging with heavy foreground/background separation. Chiaroscuro lighting cuts through atmospheric haze to isolate expressions. Camera pushes in on micro-expressions; wide shots emphasize spatial depth and isolation. Color palette shifts from cool blues/greys (tension) to warm ambers (resolution).

acts.function: Establish immediate stakes, escalate physical/emotional tension, deliver reversal, release into communal relief.

beats.action: MOSS slams a padded hand over the brass device. FINN lunges into frame, blocking the light.
beats.dialogue: Don’t move! The needle just snapped!
beats.audio_cue: Sharp metallic CLACK followed by sudden room silence. Low sub-bass drone fades in.
beats.performance: MOSS: Wide-eyed, voice tight, defensive posture. FINN: Aggressive lean, eyes locked on device, breath visible in cold air.

continuity.wardrobe: MOSS: Worn leather satchel strap. FINN: Frayed blue scarf.
continuity.screen_direction: Over-the-shoulder push-in on device, shallow depth of field isolates hands.

beats.action: FINN snatches the base, tilting it toward a moonbeam.
beats.dialogue: It’s not snapped. It’s pointing at your shadow!
beats.audio_cue: Fabric rustle, glass creak. Drone pitch rises slightly.
beats.performance: FINN: Smug but strained, jaw set. MOSS: Eyes track the tilt, pupils dilate.

continuity.wardrobe: MOSS: Worn leather satchel strap. FINN: Frayed blue scarf.
continuity.screen_direction: Two-shot, split lighting. Left side cool, right side warm.

beats.action: MOSS yanks the device back, stepping into deep foreground.
beats.dialogue: My shadow doesn’t have a pivot joint!
beats.audio_cue: Heavy footstep on gravel. Metallic hinge GROAN echoes.
beats.performance: MOSS: Defensive hunch, voice cracks on 'joint'. FINN: Steps forward, shoulders tense.

continuity.wardrobe: MOSS: Worn leather satchel strap. FINN: Frayed blue scarf.
continuity.screen_direction: Low angle, device dominates frame center.

beats.action: Silence. They stare at each other. Moss’s ear twitches.
beats.audio_cue: Ambient wind dies. Only a high-frequency string harmonic sustains.
beats.performance: MOSS: Micro-expression of doubt flickers, then hardens. FINN: Holds gaze, chest heaving.

continuity.wardrobe: MOSS: Worn leather satchel strap. FINN: Frayed blue scarf.
continuity.screen_direction: Extreme close-up on eyes, rack focus between them.

beats.action: FINN points a claw at the glass dome.
beats.audio_cue: Fingernail TAP on glass. Harmonic drops an octave.
beats.performance: FINN: Voice low, controlled but trembling with suppressed panic.

continuity.wardrobe: MOSS: Worn leather satchel strap. FINN: Frayed blue scarf.
continuity.screen_direction: Profile shot, moonlight backlighting FINN’s silhouette.

beats.action: MOSS looks down. The device slips from both hands.
beats.audio_cue: Fabric rip, object falling in slow motion. Music cuts to dead air.
beats.performance: MOSS: Eyes widen, posture collapses slightly. FINN: Reaches too late, fingers curl into fists.

continuity.wardrobe: MOSS: Worn leather satchel strap. FINN: Frayed blue scarf.
continuity.screen_direction: High angle, device lands between them in deep focus.

beats.action: Footsteps on stone. WREN steps into frame, backlit by a full moon.
beats.dialogue: Both of you are reading the dust.
beats.audio_cue: Leather sole SCRAPE on stone. Warm cello note enters softly.
beats.performance: WREN: Calm delivery, weight shifted to one hip, eyes scanning the object not them.

continuity.wardrobe: WREN: Natural charcoal plumage, no costume. MOSS/FINN: Unchanged.
continuity.screen_direction: Wide shot, WREN centered in background archway.

beats.action: WREN picks up the device, flips it over. The glass dome cracks open.
beats.audio_cue: Glass POP, dried moss CRUMBLES to floor. Cello swells gently.
beats.performance: MOSS/FINN: Shoulders drop, heads tilt forward in unison. Eyes track the falling debris.

continuity.wardrobe: WREN: Natural charcoal plumage. MOSS/FINN: Unchanged.
continuity.screen_direction: Close-up on hands, shallow depth isolates the hollow interior.

beats.action: WREN taps the empty brass base.
beats.dialogue: It’s a paperweight. You’ve been fighting over a smudge.
beats.audio_cue: Two hollow CLINKS. Ambient wind returns, softer now.
beats.performance: WREN: Matter-of-fact, slight upward tilt of head. MOSS/FINN: Exchange a look, tension bleeding out.

continuity.wardrobe: WREN: Natural charcoal plumage. MOSS/FINN: Unchanged.
continuity.screen_direction: Three-shot, lighting warms as moonbeam shifts.

beats.action: MOSS looks at FINN. FINN looks at MOSS. A snort escapes.
beats.audio_cue: Breathy laugh builds, joined by second voice. Light percussion (shaker) enters.
beats.performance: FINN: Shoulders shake, head throws back. MOSS: Covers mouth, eyes crinkle, joins in.

continuity.screen_direction: Medium two-shot, camera slowly orbits 180 degrees.

beats.action: FINN wipes an eye, gestures to the empty base.
beats.audio_cue: Laughter peaks, then naturally decays. Shaker fades.
beats.performance: FINN: Voice thick with mirth, relaxed posture. MOSS: Nods vigorously, grinning.

continuity.screen_direction: Close-up on FINN, rack focus to MOSS’s reaction.

beats.action: WREN taps the base twice. All three laugh as moonlight washes over them.
beats.audio_cue: Final cello chord resolves. Wind carries away last breaths of laughter.
beats.performance: WREN: Smiles, taps device gently. MOSS/FINN: Shoulders touch, posture open and relaxed.

continuity.screen_direction: Wide shot, deep focus captures all three in warm amber light.

characters.name: MOSS
characters.visual_lock: Round, moss-green fur with bioluminescent vein patterns. Large expressive eyes.
characters.wardrobe: Worn leather satchel strap across chest, scuffed boots.
characters.performance: Jittery, defensive, physically reactive. Eyes drive emotional shifts.

characters.name: FINN
characters.visual_lock: Tall, copper-orange scales, sharp pointed ears, angular jawline.
characters.performance: Aggressive but easily flustered. Leans into frame, uses hands to punctuate.

characters.name: WREN
characters.visual_lock: Sleek charcoal plumage, calm posture, glowing amber eyes, tall silhouette.
characters.wardrobe: Natural texture only, no costume elements.
characters.performance: Grounded, deliberate movements. Authority through stillness and warm delivery.

locations.name: RUINED OBSERVATORY
locations.visual_lock: Overgrown stone archway, deep foreground foliage, cracked marble floor. Dramatic shafts of moonlight cut through suspended dust motes. Heavy 3D depth separation.

props.name: BRASS ASTROLABE
props.state: Tarnished brass casing, cracked glass dome, hollow interior packed with dried moss and dust. Needle detaches easily when flipped.

edit_plan.pacing: Starts tight and staccato (2-3 sec shots) to build pressure. Midpoint holds on silence for realization. Final act widens to fluid orbits and longer takes as tension dissolves.
edit_plan.audio_strategy: Diegetic foley drives rhythm. Music enters only at reversal (SC_003_B01) and resolves with laughter. Silence used strategically in SC_002_B01 to amplify physical performance. Low-frequency drones underscore conflict; warm cello/percussion underscores resolution.
edit_plan.transition_strategy: Match cuts on eye lines and object orientation. Hard cuts on dialogue spikes for comedic timing. Cross-dissolve only at final wide shot to emphasize emotional release.
